items.prompt: The report ___ by the marketing team last Friday.
items.explanation: Passive past simple: was/were + past participle.

items.prompt: Choose the sentence that keeps the agent:
options: The bridge was built by engineers in 1960.
items.explanation: 'By engineers' names the agent — the others omit or distort it.

items.prompt: It is believed ___ the company will grow next year.
items.explanation: Impersonal passive with 'it is believed that...'.

items.prompt: Complete with the passive form: Coffee ___ (grow) in many countries around the world.
items.explanation: Present simple passive: is/are + past participle.

items.prompt: Rewrite in the passive: "The chef cooked the meal."
answers: The meal was cooked by the chef
items.explanation: The object becomes the subject; the agent follows 'by'.

items.prompt: Rewrite using 'it is said': "People say that the exam is hard."
answers: It is said that the exam is hard
It is said that the exam is hard.
items.explanation: The impersonal passive moves 'people' out and starts with 'it is said that...'.
